entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David, agent ID 304. How can I help you today?
Hi... yes, hello. I have a problem with an order. I'm just so confused by all of this. I bought a jersey and it's not right.
I can certainly look into that for you. To start, could I get your name and order number, please?
Yes, the name is Sarah Miller. The order number is... um... VF88-12345. I think.
Thank you, Sarah. I see your order for the ClubFit Jersey right here. Can you tell me, what specifically is the issue with the jersey? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

Oh, I don't know about technical things. It's just the wrong size. I always get a medium, but this one is just way too tight. The whole thing feels off. I need to do an exchange, I guess, but the website was... a lot. Can't you just help me?

Of course, I can absolutely help you with that. I see here that your item was delivered 19 days ago. Let me just check the policy for you... Yes, you're well within our 90-day return window for standard items. We can definitely get this sorted out.
Oh, thank goodness. I was so worried I was stuck with it.

Not at all. I can process an exchange for a different size right now. And since I see you're a VIP member with VeloFit, I'm going to go ahead and waive the return shipping fee and provide complimentary express shipping on your new jersey.
Really? Oh, that is such a relief! Thank you so much, David. That's wonderful.
It's my pleasure, Sarah. I'm sending a prepaid return label to your email now. Which size would you like for the new ClubFit Jersey?
A Large, please. That should work.

Excellent. I have a new order placed for one ClubFit Jersey in size Large, with express shipping, at no additional cost to you. You'll receive a confirmation email shortly. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. You've been a huge help. Thank you again!
You are very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
